retrievalProfile.description: A textured, hand-colored etching style featuring high-contrast lighting and dense cross-hatching typical of 19th-century narrative illustrations.

recipe.visualDefinition: A painterly scene characterized by heavy stippling and cross-hatching textures, mimicking a copperplate engraving that has been layered with translucent oil glazes. The lighting is dramatic, with deep shadows and glowing highlights on fabric and skin.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject interaction across a central wooden furniture anchor
Contrast between soft fabric textures and coarse animal fur
Dark, atmospheric background framing brightly lit central figures
Textured stippling unifying the foreground and background elements
coreInvariants: Visible cross-hatching and etching lines throughout all surfaces
Muted, earthy color palette with one primary cool-toned garment

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A child in a voluminous dress occupies the right half, balanced by a large dog on the left, both centered around a small wooden table.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The dark, ornate wooden table in the lower-center foreground.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye follows the child's gaze and reaching hand toward the dog, creating a circular narrative flow.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Dense and textured, filled with dark foliage-like patterns that push the subjects forward.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep forest greens and umber browns providing a dark, textured base.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Pale cerulean blue for the child's dress, acting as the primary light source.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Warm ochre and muted reds in the small details and skin tones.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value contrast between the dark background and the luminous central figures.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid pure white; use cream or pale blue for highlights

letterConstructionRules: High contrast between thick and thin strokes
Elongated, stylized serifs with organic curves
Interlocking or tightly kerned character relationships
characterSpecificRedesigns: Uppercase 'M' with flared, curved outer legs
Lowercase 'g' with a stylized, open descender loop

composition.relationshipToImage: Floating over dark areas for legibility

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single decorative typeface used for both title and artist name to maintain period consistency.
graphicDevices: Small circular emblem in the bottom corner

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the organic, Art Nouveau curves and weight.
Captures the stylized, high-waisted Victorian display feel.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a hand-colored etching of a child in a blue Victorian dress sitting at a dark wooden table with a large dog, using dense cross-hatching and oil wash textures.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply custom Art Nouveau lettering in a cream color at the top and bottom center, ensuring the text has a slight organic wobble to match the hand-drawn style.

verificationChecks: Is the cross-hatching texture visible across all surfaces?
Does the blue dress act as the primary light-value anchor?
Is the typography stylized with Art Nouveau curves?

adjustableVariables: Complexity of the wooden table carvings
postGenerationChecks: Ensure no modern artifacts are present in the texture.
Verify the dog's fur has a distinct etched quality.
Check that the text is legible against the dark background.
Confirm the color palette remains muted and antique.
recipe.reuseFormula: Victorian Etching + Chiaroscuro Lighting + Art Nouveau Typography + Hand-Colored Oil Wash
